author: Ryan Mense
title: Elderly pedestrian fatally struck by car in North Bay - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Mense ,
12 hours ago
( KRON ) — A 91-year-old man was fatally struck by a car as he crossed the road in Fairfax’s Oak Manor neighborhood on Tuesday, according to the California Highway Patrol.
The collision occurred around 6:45 p.m. on Sir Francis Drake Boulevard, east of Shadow Creek Court. CHP determined that a 22-year-old Martinez man was driving a white Volkswagen Passat westbound when he struck the 91-year-old who was crossing the roadway northward.
(KRON4) The identity of the pedestrian was not immediately available.
The driver was the sole occupant of the car and was uninjured in the crash, CHP said.
Authorities do not believe alcohol or drugs were factors in the deadly collision. The driver was not arrested.
